response.text: Nulls display as "NULL" (real nulls). Now I'll check the GL balances, the reversal journals, and the AP-to-GL links.

arguments.sql: SELECT h."SRC_CD", count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN l.dr=l.cr THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) unbalanced, sum(l.dr) dr, sum(l.cr) cr, sum(CASE WHEN l.lines IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nolines FROM "GLJRNH" h LEFT JOIN (SELECT "JRNL_NO", sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr, count(*) lines FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1) l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY 1

SELECT h.*, (SELECT string_agg(l."LN_SEQ"||':'||l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||'/'||l."CR_AMT", ' | ' ORDER BY l."LN_SEQ") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") lines FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_CD"='GL' ORDER BY h."JRNL_NO" LIMIT 20

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_DT", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."JRNL_NO", p."PAY_ID", p."PAY_DT", p."PAY_AMT", (SELECT string_agg(l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||'/'||l."CR_AMT", ' | ') FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") invlines, h."SRC_REF", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT" FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" LEFT JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" ORDER BY i."INV_ID" LIMIT 8

SELECT 'inv orphan vend' k, count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv orphan jrnl', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay orphan inv', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'line orphan hdr', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'line orphan acct', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" a WHERE a."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr orphan prd', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'paid w/o pay', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'open with pay', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay amt<>inv amt', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING ("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv with >1 pay', count(*) FROM (SELECT "INV_ID" FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'line both dr&cr or neither', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE ("DR_AMT">0 AND "CR_AMT">0) OR ("DR_AMT"=0 AND "CR_AMT"=0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'negative amts', (SELECT count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<0 OR "CR_AMT"<0)+(SELECT count(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<0)+(SELECT count(*) FROM "APPAYM" WHERE "PAY_AMT"<0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnl date outside period', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING ("PRD_ID") WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'posted after close in closed prd', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING ("PRD_ID") WHERE p."CLOSE_DT" IS NOT NULL AND h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT"
